name: Close Cohort
body:
You and your cohort are nearly equals.

Prerequisite(s): Leadership or ability that grants a cohort, leadership score 2 higher than your level

Benefit(s): Your cohort may be one level lower than you.

Normal: Regardless of your leadership score, you can only recruit a cohort who is two or more levels lower than you. Your cohort cannot gain levels to bring them within one level of you.
